newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Caltex Philippine unit to lower LPG price.
newsitem.headline: Caltex Philippine unit to lower LPG price.

text.p: Caltex Philippines Inc will reduce the price of its liquefied petroleum gasoline by 25 centavos per litre, a top official of the company said on Saturday.
Caltex vice-president for logistics Frank Cruz told Reuters the price cut will be effective not later than March 17. The final effectivity date is yet to be finalised.
At present, Caltex sells LPG at 7.8257 per litre.
Caltex Philippines is a unit of Caltex Petroleum Corp, a joint venture between Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
"I have no doubt that we will follow the price cuts of the other oil refiners," Cruz said.
Petron Corp and Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp announced on Friday a 25 centavo per litre cut which translates to a five-peso reduction per 11-kilo cylinder of LPG.
This is the second time that oil firms have adjusted the price of LPG since the oil industry was fully deregulated last February 8.
